DISCHARGE SUMMARY
Diagnosis: Cellulitis, left leg.

MEDICATIONS:
1. Cephalexin 500 mg capsules -- take one capsule four times daily for 7 days.
2. Ibuprofen 200 mg tablets -- take 1 to 2 tablets every 6 hours as needed for pain.

FOLLOW-UP: See Dr. Patel in 3 days for a wound check.

RETURN PRECAUTIONS: Go to the emergency room if you have spreading redness, fever over 100.4F, or increased pain.

ACTIVITY: Keep your leg raised. No running for 2 weeks.
